_doc: RANK power-meter policy (FUEL-SPINE v1, user design 2026-07-07/08). Deterministic POWER/speed estimate — ORTHOGONAL to the consistency tier. calibrated:false: constants provisional, tunable without code. Provenance in data/rank-calibration/NOTES.md (24-deck corpus). Thesis: power = speed; fast_mana (rocks/rituals) is THE cEDH separator (0 false positives across 24 decks), tutors a CAPPED secondary (consistency), never co-spine.

weights._doc: Composite = fast·0.55 + tutor·0.20 + gc·0.10 + curve·0.10 + free·0.05, ×10. fast dominates (the spine). Draw deliberately EXCLUDED: measured HIGHER in casual than cEDH (a grind signal owned by the consistency tier), not a speed signal.

denominators._doc: Saturation points: metric/denominator, capped at 1.0. fast_mana 12 = a fully-committed cEDH mana engine; tutor 12; gc 10; free 6.

curve._doc: curve = clamp((pivot - avg_mv_nonland) / span, 0, 1). avg_mv 2.0 → 1.0, 3.5 → 0. Low curve is universal in cEDH (2.05-2.70) but NOT sufficient (battlecruisers also curve low), hence low weight.

bands._doc: 7-band scale on the 0..1 composite (score/10). Top/bottom anchored to the corpus; mid interpolated (calibrated:false). Names: user design.

fast_mana._doc: NONCREATURE acceleration only (rocks / rituals / fast lands). Dorks & auras excluded on purpose: 'fuel' = mana that doesn't die to creature removal / isn't summoning-sick; the corpus average baseline is ~1 with this list. Name-matched (case-insensitive, DFC front-face).

free_interaction._doc: Free / pitch interaction (0-mana or alternative-cost). Color-bound (blue-heavy) → weighted low, additive only, never required.
